english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something conspicuous or visually noticeable, including a prominent position.

exampleSentences.english: That sign is so big that it is prominent.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 go3 ziu1 paai4 gam3 daai6 hou2 hin2 ngaan5

english.note: Choose this when something is especially conspicuous or stands out visually.

exampleSentences.english: Your orange jacket is really noticeable.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你件橙色外套真係好顯眼。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gin6 caang2 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hin2 ngaan5

english.note: Use this for something conspicuous or visually prominent that easily attracts notice.

exampleSentences.english: That bright red coat makes them especially notable in the crowd.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢着住件鮮紅色外套，喺人群中特別顯眼。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 sin1 hung4 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 hai2 jan4 kwan4 zung1 dak6 bit6 hin2 ngaan5
